description: This Python source file implements an AWS Bedrock Language Model (LLM) adapter for the Pipecat project. It provides classes and methods to convert and handle messages, functions, and invocation parameters suited for AWS Bedrock's APIs, including message processing, content formatting, and tool schema conversion.

classes.name: AWSBedrockLLMInvocationParams
classes.description: TypedDict for parameters used in invoking the AWS Bedrock LLM API, including system messages, user messages, tools, and tool choice.

classes.name: AWSBedrockLLMAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for integrating AWS Bedrock LLM with Pipecat, providing message conversion, parameter formation, and logging utilities.

classes.name: ConvertedMessages
classes.description: Data class encapsulating the converted list of messages and optional system message, after processing universal context messages.

methods.name: str id_for_llm_specific_messages(self)
methods.description: Returns a stable identifier string ('aws') used in LLM-specific messages for AWS Bedrock.

methods.name: AWSBedrockLLMInvocationParams get_llm_invocation_params(self, context: LLMContext)
methods.description: Constructs and returns the AWS Bedrock-specific invocation parameters based on the provided LLM context.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_messages_for_logging(self, context)
methods.description: Prepares messages suitable for secure, sanitized logging by removing or masking sensitive data.

methods.name: ConvertedMessages _from_universal_context_messages( self, universal_context_messages: List[LLMContextMessage] )
methods.description: Converts a list of universal LLM context messages into AWS Bedrock format, handling system messages, message concatenation, and role adjustments.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] _from_universal_context_message(self, message: LLMContextMessage)
methods.description: Converts a single universal message into AWS Bedrock message format, handling specific message types.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] _from_standard_message(self, message: LLMStandardMessage)
methods.description: Converts a standard message into AWS Bedrock format, managing role-specific content, JSON parsing, and image data conversion.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _to_bedrock_function_format(function: FunctionSchema)
methods.description: Transforms a FunctionSchema into AWS Bedrock's tool specification format.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] to_provider_tools_format(self, tools_schema: ToolsSchema)
methods.description: Converts a ToolsSchema containing functions into a list of AWS Bedrock-compatible function definitions.

ctags.name: to_provider_tools_format
ctags.pattern: /^    def to_provider_tools_format(self, tools_schema: ToolsSchema) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:$/
